children: Norway's DNO (DNO.OL) reported third-quarter operational results on Wednesday:
North Sea net production rose to 85,364 barrels of oil equivalent per day (boepd) from 77,324 boepd in the third quarter of 2025
North Sea realised oil prices increased to $99.6 per barrel from $72 per barrel a year earlier
North Sea realised gas prices climbed to $122.9 per barrel of oil equivalent (boe) from $63.8 per boe
Crude oil sales in Iraq's Kurdistan region nearly doubled to 28,058 boepd from 14,449 boepd in the third quarter of 2025 and compared with zero in the second quarter of 2026
Realised oil prices in Kurdistan increased to $38.5 per barrel from $31.2 per barrel in the third quarter of 2025
DNO resumed production in Kurdistan at the end of June after shutting operations for security reasons following the US-Israeli attacks on Iran in late February
Gross production at the DNO-operated Tawke and Peshkabir oilfields in Kurdistan rose to 73,219 barrels per day (bpd) from 46,572 bpd a year earlier
